answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of our framework based on metrics from two perspectives. From this perspective, we use metrics associated with the gameplay outcome and strategies to quantitatively evaluate the performance... Winning Rate (WR). The winning rate is the percentage of games won out of the total played... Quest Engagement Rate (QER). 'Quest engagement rate' is the ratio of rounds a player joins the quest team to the total rounds played...
